answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through stake-weighted mutual attestation. Each identity locks copper as a collateral bond and may only vouch for peers it has really traded with, so influence flows along a trellis of signed vouchers rather than raw account count. A cloned army stranded on an island with no links to honest agents earns zero weight. To gain one more vote the attacker must pay the full bond for each fake identity and slowly win genuine counterparties, turning every Sybil into sunk, forfeitable capital.
